description: Java class defining the PushBlockStream message used in Spark's shuffle protocol for pushing data blocks to remote shuffle services.

classes.name: PushBlockStream
classes.description: Represents a request to push a data block to a remote shuffle service in Spark, including metadata such as app ID, shuffle IDs, map and reduce indices, and block index.
